heal_pokemon_at_counter.description: Initiates and completes the healing dialogue with Nurse Joy at the counter, ensuring no automatic B presses cancel the menu. Prints the button sequence.
heal_pokemon_at_counter.python_script:
import json

# Precise button sequence to talk to Nurse Joy and complete healing:
# 1. Press A to talk
# 2. Sleep 1500ms for "Welcome..."
# 3. Press A to advance
# 4. Sleep 1500ms for "We heal..."
# 5. Press A to advance
# 6. Sleep 1500ms for "Shall we heal..." and HEAL/CANCEL menu to appear
# 7. Press A to select HEAL
# 8. Sleep 5500ms for the healing animation and jingle
# 9. Press A to advance "Thank you..."
# 10. Sleep 1500ms for "We hope..."
# 11. Press A to finish conversation
# 12. Sleep 1000ms to exit text box

buttons = [
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 5500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1000"
]

print(json.dumps(buttons))

history.commit_message: Define a custom tool to safely heal Pokémon at the counter by disabling the harness auto-advance and pressing buttons with precise sleep times.

navigate_overworld.description: Plans and generates a sequence of overworld movement button presses ('Up', 'Down', 'Left', 'Right') using a BFS pathfinder to navigate safely around obstacles, ledges, and trainers on Route 25, Route 24, and Cerulean City. Directly uses the pre-injected input_data variable for parameter access.

start_x.description: The starting X coordinate of the player.

start_y.description: The starting Y coordinate of the player.

map_id.description: The current map ID (e.g. '0_36' for Route 25, '0_35' for Route 24, '0_3' for Cerulean City).

history.commit_message: Initial definition of the navigate_overworld custom tool.
Corrected tool parameter input mechanism to read from pre-injected input_data global variable instead of sys.stdin.
